title: Where the Bridge Becomes a Guess
statement: A map, a photographed bridge, and a catalogued insect offer things that can be inspected. Their borrowed certainty gives way to an unfinished observer holding a mechanism, and to fragments that invite the eye to invent a continuation. The ornamental circle cannot close. Beyond its opening, unoccupied paper marks not an answer concealed, but a limit I cannot honestly fill.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent the boundary between what you know, what you infer, and what you cannot know.

actions.title: Where the Bridge Becomes a Guess
actions.statement: A map, a photographed bridge, and a catalogued insect offer things that can be inspected. Their borrowed certainty gives way to an unfinished observer holding a mechanism, and to fragments that invite the eye to invent a continuation. The ornamental circle cannot close. Beyond its opening, unoccupied paper marks not an answer concealed, but a limit I cannot honestly fill.

notes.note: Begin with a mapped territory and an incomplete ornamental aperture. The map gives a measured ground; the open ring will frame an area the composition refuses to fill.
Introduce an unfinished human figure at the boundary and a photographic bridge that reaches toward—but does not complete—the opening. Keep the right side materially empty.
Clarify the observer’s silhouette and put the mechanism into her hands. Break the bridge’s continuation into diminishing photographic slivers, leaving the aperture open beyond them.
Add one small, sharply observed specimen within the mapped territory, contrasting it with the fading bridge and unfinished observer. Keep the open right-hand field untouched.

Their borrowed certainty gives way to an unfinished observer holding a mechanism, and to fragments that invite the eye to invent a continuation. The ornamental circle cannot close. Beyond its opening, unoccupied paper marks not an answer concealed, but a limit I cannot honestly fill.

notes.note: The final canvas balances the dense mapped territory with an open, unfilled field. The bridge’s diminishing fragments make inference visible without closing the gap; the observer and specimen anchor the measured side. No further additions are needed.
